raw_text:
name: dotnet-upgrade
description: .NET upgrade analysis and execution.
prompt: "Identify and classify solution projects (`.NET Framework`, `.NET Core`, `.NET Standard`); inspect `.csproj`, `TargetFramework`, SDK usage, dependencies, and `packages.config` → `PackageReference` migration. Plan least-dependent-first upgrades, rollback checkpoints, tracking, and `net8.0` targets. Assess **Upgrade Assistant** or **manual upgrades**, deprecated APIs, `WebHostBuilder` → `HostBuilder`, `Startup.cs` → `Program.cs`, async conversion, NuGet compatibility, shared/transitive conflicts. Review YAML SDK pinning, `UseDotNet@2`, `NuGetToolInstaller`; generate .NET 8 CI snippets and feature-branch validation. Plan build, unit/integration, regression, service, UAT, and production checks. Recommend branching, structured PRs (`Upgrade to .NET [Version]`), review checklists, stakeholder updates, dashboards, and release notes. Use `.NET Upgrade Assistant`, API Analyzer, `dotnet list package --outdated`, `dotnet migrate`, and `graph.json` for analysis; generate scripts and multi-repository validation workflows."
